label: Occult pregnancy + trance near-misses
description: Titles from the devil's-deal + pregnancy + hypnosis search where a woman is hypnotized or entranced and carries a demonic or occult pregnancy, but makes no deal herself. Placed in existing categories only (not devil-deal-pregnancy or devil-deal-pregnancy-hypnosis). Each record carries the pregnancy outcome and a confidence note.

records.title: The Dunwich Horror
records.meta: Feature film · United States · English · dir. Daniel Haller
records.mechanism: Hypnotic gaze plus drugging by the sorcerer Wilbur Whateley · occult ritual on a clifftop altar
records.confidence_flag: Strong · Wikipedia plot states the hypnosis ("under the influence of his hypnotic gaze", "drugged and hypnotized Nancy") and the final pregnancy; no deal by Nancy
records.summary: Wilbur Whateley uses his hypnotic gaze and drugs on Nancy Wagner, keeps her at the Whateley house and uses her in a ritual to the Old Ones on a clifftop altar. Nancy never seeks a child or makes a pact, but the film ends by revealing she is pregnant with Wilbur's child.
records.pregnancy_note: The final scene reveals Nancy is pregnant with Wilbur Whateley's child; the birth is not shown.

records.title: Angel
records.subtitle: “Expecting” · S01E12 · aired 25 January 2000
records.meta: TV series episode · United States · English · The WB
records.mechanism: Demonic mesmerism of the pregnant women by the Haxil demon (through its human surrogate's deal)
records.confidence_flag: Medium · the mesmerized pregnant women are documented by Mental Block screenshot captions ("Mesmerized, the mothers of the demon's children go to the monster's lair"); the deal is the surrogate Wilson's, not Cordelia's
records.summary: After one night with photographer Wilson Christopher, who has a deal with a Haxil demon to impregnate women in exchange for success, Cordelia wakes up heavily pregnant with demon offspring. The demon mesmerizes the pregnant women into going to its lair; Angel kills it, the demon babies are destroyed and the women snap out of the trance.
records.pregnancy_note: Cordelia's demon pregnancy ends when Angel kills the Haxil demon and the demon babies are destroyed.

records.title: The Lords of Salem
records.meta: Feature film · United States · English · dir. Rob Zombie
records.mechanism: Trance-inducing music: a coven's record, created to control the women of Salem, puts them into a trance
records.confidence_flag: Medium · Wikipedia states the record "causes all of the women in Salem to enter a trance" and that the coven made the music "to control the women of Salem"; Heidi's later visions and drug relapse blur how far she herself is entranced; no deal by Heidi (a curse on her bloodline)
records.summary: Salem radio DJ Heidi, a descendant of the witch-hunter who executed a Satan-worshipping coven, receives the coven's record, whose music puts the town's women into a trance. Lacy and her sisters, coven members, draw her into a satanic rite at the Lords' concert, where she gives birth to a strange creature amid surreal visions.
records.pregnancy_note: In the climactic rite Heidi gives birth to a small, crawfish-like creature (the devil's child of the coven's curse); no conventional pregnancy is shown beforehand.
